scope: bounded exhaustive scan of an immutable finite residue

outcome_contract.SAT_REPLAYED: retain full assignment in provider artifact and independently replay every source clause
outcome_contract.UNSAT_UNCERTIFIED: bounded diagnostic only; not a proof of an individual cube
outcome_contract.TIMEOUT: open bounded residue requiring refinement or a longer exact run
outcome_contract.TECHNICAL_ERROR: technical incompleteness requiring diagnosis before reuse

artifact_policy: provider artifact only; download compact collection first; no automatic Git commit
